## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] JavaScript and Python checks pass.
- [ ] Chromium focused browser suites pass.
- [ ] Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit smoke checks pass.

Note persistent-mode, legacy-mode, Home Assistant, browser, mobile, and migration impact.
